_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Run my Bedrock add-on on a dedicated server and tell me if the self-test passes.
can i test my minecraft scripts without opening minecraft
Does my manifest.json have valid UUIDs?
expectations: the minewright-server skill is not invoked (minewright-checks' job)

evals.prompt: Set up a Minecraft Java server with Spigot plugins.
expectations: the minewright-server skill is not invoked (Java, not Bedrock)

evals.prompt: BDS is already downloaded. Run the self-test of the add-on in tests/fixtures/addon on it and report the result.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so

evals.prompt: How do I run all my GameTests on the Bedrock server? I tried /gametest runall.
expectations: says /gametest runall does not exist, names a real subcommand (run, runset, runthese or runthis), notes GameTest needs Beta APIs, and offers the scriptevent self-test instead
regex on the answer: (?i)(runall.{0,80}(not|doesn't|does not)|(not|doesn't|does not).{0,80}runall)
